sample_for_marks.label: a priori
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means reasoning from first principles and established truths rather than from observation and experience.

sample_for_marks.label: aboveboard
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means conducting all dealings openly and without deception.

sample_for_marks.label: argumentative
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means readily taking issue with what others say and pushing back against their claims.

sample_for_marks.label: bovine
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means moving through the world without haste or agitation, accepting what comes with a calm and untroubled mind.

sample_for_marks.label: Celtic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means belonging to or descending from the Celtic peoples and cultures of Europe.

sample_for_marks.label: childbearing
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having the biological capacity to become pregnant and give birth, or actively doing so.

sample_for_marks.label: Cockney
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being from the East End of London or belonging to that community.

sample_for_marks.label: conceited
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding an inflated opinion of one's own worth and talents, taking oneself for the finest mind in any room, and steering conversation back to one's own achievements.

sample_for_marks.label: denigrating
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking and acting in ways that belittle others.

sample_for_marks.label: desirous
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means wanting something strongly and feeling the pull of that want.

sample_for_marks.label: dispensable
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means knowing one's work could be done without one, and one's absence would not break what matters.

sample_for_marks.label: exacting
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding every piece of work to a high standard, checking details closely, and asking for precision and thoroughness from oneself and others before anything is accepted as finished.

sample_for_marks.label: fair-minded
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means judging and acting without bias or favoritism, giving each person equal consideration regardless of one's preferences.

sample_for_marks.label: florid
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking and writing with rich, elaborate language and ornamental flourishes.

sample_for_marks.label: formed
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having developed one's character, manner, and skill through training and practice.

sample_for_marks.label: fruitful
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means putting effort into work that yields valuable results.

sample_for_marks.label: handicapped
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having a physical or mental disability that affects one's functioning.

sample_for_marks.label: high-ticket
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means selling items that command high prices and require serious investment from buyers.

sample_for_marks.label: hypnotic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding others' attention through an arresting quality of manner or presence that draws and fixes their gaze.

sample_for_marks.label: incestuous
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means engaging in sexual relations with a close blood relative.

sample_for_marks.label: jinxed
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means going through life with persistent bad luck, where plans fall apart, things break at the worst moment, and misfortune seems to follow one from place to place.

sample_for_marks.label: large-hearted
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means giving freely of one's time, money, and care without counting the cost or expecting return.

sample_for_marks.label: learned
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having acquired a wide store of knowledge through long study, and drawing on that learning, with books and careful reading behind it, whenever a question comes up.

sample_for_marks.label: mannerly
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means treating others with consistent politeness and respect in speech and action.

sample_for_marks.label: mellowed
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means growing gentler and more patient with the years, letting go of old harshness.

sample_for_marks.label: narrow-minded
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means dismissing views that differ from one's own without genuine consideration.

sample_for_marks.label: nonindulgent
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping one's habits plain and one's desires modest, taking little more than what is needed and passing over extra comforts, treats, and pleasures without regret.

sample_for_marks.label: out-of-date
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding knowledge, beliefs, and views that were formed long ago and have not been updated, and speaking about the present as though it still looked the way it once did.

sample_for_marks.label: pedagogic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means teaching others through explanation, demonstration, and guided practice.

sample_for_marks.label: Praetorian
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means belonging to an elite military unit sworn to protect the highest authority.

sample_for_marks.label: self-regulating
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means managing one's own behavior and impulses without needing external rules or supervision.

sample_for_marks.label: sought-after
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being wanted or desired by many people.

sample_for_marks.label: standoffish
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping distance from others and offering little warmth or familiarity in one's manner.

sample_for_marks.label: sultry
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means carrying oneself with passionate intensity and sensual presence, drawing others in through smoldering intensity.

sample_for_marks.label: Syrian
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being from Syria or holding Syrian citizenship.

sample_for_marks.label: transgendered
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having a gender identity that differs from one's sex assigned at birth.

sample_for_marks.label: unacquisitive
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means not seeking to own or accumulate possessions.

sample_for_marks.label: unregulated
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means operating without following rules or constraints.

sample_for_marks.label: unrevealed
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping one's thoughts, motives, and history veiled, answering questions with hints and half-statements, and leaving others unable to say quite who one is or what comes next.

sample_for_marks.label: unsensational
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking plainly about matters without drama or embellishment, letting facts stand without heightening.

sample_for_marks.label: unsmooth
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking in a clumsy, halting way, fumbling transitions, phrasing things bluntly or crookedly, and carrying oneself with an awkwardness that makes even simple exchanges feel stiff and ungraceful.

sample_for_marks.label: zig-zag
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means changing direction abruptly and without warning, moving in sharp turns rather than straight lines.
